description: One page of the resources a text search found, and which kind of answer it is.

total.description: How many resources the search found in all, and not only on this page.

offset.description: The offset the search was made with.

limit.description: The limit the search was made with.

matchKind.description: What kind of answer this is: 'lexical' — the resources matched the query text; 'semantic' — no lexical match existed, and these resources discuss the query per the vector index. Required so every producer labels its answer; a UI can render semantic results as a different kind of page ('no title matches, but these documents discuss it').
